brief.text: Hi team, we need an Instagram post for our New Year offer. It has to say "FLAT 40% OFF" and "First 100 members only" and our gym name AlphaFit. Offer ends 15 January, that should come through as well. Make it bold and energetic, something people notice while scrolling. Use our brand colours, black and neon yellow. No pictures of people, we do not have good photos of the gym yet. We will drop our logo on ourselves, just leave a clean corner for it. Square post. Thanks, Rohan
